candidates.description: This feature vector represents German auxiliary, modal, and common finite verbs.
This vector represents abstract intellectual concepts, theories, and critical analysis.
This vector activates for tokens related to the root word "analysis" and its morphological variants.
This feature vector represents terms and roots related to the mind, psychology, and mental states.
This feature represents psychological concepts related to the subconscious mind, obsessions, and mental states.
This vector represents medical terminology related to healthcare, patients, and clinical treatments.
This feature activates on words related to sex, sexuality, and sexual orientation across multiple languages.
This vector represents multilingual discourse markers and adverbial modifiers indicating addition, sequence, or emphasis.
